quest.title: Lil' Fungi's Fun-Tastic Fiesta!
quest.description: On the busy streets of Quartier Lyonnais in the Court of Fontaine, Paimon and you catch a glimpse of some Fungi...
quest.rewards_formatted: Marvelous Jelly: Improved Fontaine Edition x1, Mora x10000, Adventurer's Experience x4

talks.objective: Go and investigate where the Fungi are appearing

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Is there something wrong with Paimon's eyes?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Just now... That thing which floated off ahead... was that a Fungus? Have Fungi invaded Fontaine?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, let's go check it out!

talks.objective: Talk to the two people at the stall

dialogues.speaker: Turenna
dialogues.text: Thank you for your cooperation. The review has been completed, and your companions are all very safe. They are of no threat to Fontaine's citizens and ecological environment.

dialogues.speaker: Turenna
dialogues.text: As stated in the Fontaine Foreign Species Management Act and the Quartier Lyonnais Code of Business Conduct, you may proceed with your event.
Thank you, Ms. Turenna.
I didn't think hosting an event in Fontaine would be this complicated. It took around ten extra steps as compared to procedures at Port Ormos. I guess my preparations weren't sufficient...

dialogues.speaker: Turenna
dialogues.text: Don't mention it, and don't beat yourself up about it. You and your Fungi companions are special guests.

dialogues.speaker: Turenna
dialogues.text: The Maison Gardiennage rarely comes into contact with foreign Fungi species, so proceeding with caution was necessary. It is only normal that the observation and evaluation took quite a bit of time.

dialogues.speaker: Turenna
dialogues.text: Next, I shall be transferring your commission to the other Gardes.

dialogues.speaker: Turenna
dialogues.text: If the rumored Golden Comet and Silver Companion are spotted, the Gardes will notify them and ask them to meet you here...

dialogues.speaker: Turenna
dialogues.text: I hope your "Lil' Fungi's Fun-Tastic Fiesta" goes smoothly, and you have a great time in the Court of Fontaine... If you need anything, just call for me, and I'll be there.
Ah, it seems that won't be necessary anymore. They are already here.

dialogues.speaker: Turenna
dialogues.text: Wait a minute! By "Golden Comet and Silver Companion"... You refer to these... Super Zenith Boss-Level Forces?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! How did we suddenly become the topic of your conversation? And what's with those strange names...
You two are the same as ever, I see... Energetic, spirited, and with a reassuring air about you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wh—Wh—Who are you? Have we met?
Hmm... Your failure to remember me is my mistake. I should have done my best to maintain contact and sent a few more letters.
A long time ago, the Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament was held in Sumeru. I participated with some prejudiced thoughts and the intent to do something dangerous...
You woke me up and made me change. You helped me stop hating my kind, Fungi buddies and seek the right path toward coexisting with them.
After the event, you became the ultimate decision-maker of the tournament, and I promised that I would do my best to continue running the event...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Are you... Haniyyah? The same Haniyyah who's been taking care of Bongo-Head and the other Fungi for us?

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Yeah, that's me! Long time no see, Golden Comet, Silver Companion!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Your new look's made you completely unrecognizable! You've changed so... Well, too much! Even the way you speak has changed!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, is this some way of... making your trip to Fontaine with your Fungi buddies... special?

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: Ahem! Actually, the Court of Fontaine does not impose a dress code on its visitors. You'd be welcomed warmly here even if you were wearing a plain hunter's outfit...

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: And the way Ms. Haniyyah dresses is much more than just following a dress code, I'd say it's elegant, extremely elegant!

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Thank you so much! Your affirmation fills me with greater confidence.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Anyway, I'm here in Fontaine to search for reliable investors for the official Fungi tournament, and to host a preview event to advertise the Fungi's cuteness and attract an audience in advance.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: According to Souka, we are conducting transnational business, and Fontainians are very particular about their dress. So, when in Fontaine, do as Fontainians do.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: She prepared my preview event plans, ordered this costume for me, and even gave me special training to improve the way I carry myself.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Souka? Isn't that the light novelist who's been following you to gather material and helping you take care of the Fungi after being defeated by us?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon didn't expect her to be so well-versed in... foreign etiquette! Was she that knowledgeable!?

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: And if you still remember the tabletop game, Fungus Mechanicus, then you can give the brand-new Lil' Fungi's Fun-Tastic Fiesta a try.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: In Fungus Mechanicus, you'd direct your Fungi to defeat all the Mechanici.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: The game received a pretty good initial response, but it was lacking in long-term potential, so it quickly lost popularity...

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: As such, Souka combined elements from various documents and fiction to change the Mechanici into pieces that simulate powerful opponents, which adds all manner of variables to the game.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Souka is at the Steambird's office right now discussing the game's marketing plan.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon sorta gets it now... So the preview event, Lil' Fungi's Fun-Tastic Fiesta, is this tabletop game?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And powerful opponents, you say? Does that mean we'll be commanding Fungi pieces to clash with other creatures, and that both sides can move?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The game sounds much more complicated now... But based on past experience, Paimon's sure you still have some details to iron out and perfect, right?

choices.text: Haha! That's right up our alley!

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: Ahem... There's no need to worry. We've resolved all the issues in advance.

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: Miss Haniyyah and her Lil' Fungi's Fun-Tastic Fiesta have received the Fontaine Research Institute's... Uh... What was it again? The sponsorship of the Fonta project team, so everything is ready.

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: Even if something is left unfinished, I... Turenna, the most diligent member of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol, would never allow it to trouble you, our distinguished guests!

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: You're Super Zenith Boss-Level Forces after all, and Miss Haniyyah is an important foreign merchant, so you can just leave any odd jobs to ordinary Gardes!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: O—Oh, so you're one of the Gardes! Paimon thought you were an assistant Haniyyah hired... You're so reliable!

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: Heh! A Super Zenith Boss-Level Force recognized me... I've been acknowledged by an apex warrior!

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: Ahem! I might be getting a bit carried away...

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: As a newbie in the Special Patrol, I'm obligated to monitor foreign creatures, provide the highest levels of assistance to special guests, and resolve issues that are beyond the ability of ordinary Gardes.

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: If Fungi-related events can bring considerable economic benefit to the Court of Fontaine... Then I would be considered to have accumulated experience that goes beyond combat, and our captain would value me more...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, don't be so serious! It's just a game! Relax!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: In Paimon's opinion, anything linked to Fungi tends to help people forget their troubles and be happy!

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: In that case, I happen to have a suggestion.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Souka and I have tried "Lil' Fungi's Fun-Tastic Fiesta" several hundred times, but we represent only two types of players, whereas the guests have the most diverse mentalities.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: As it happens, the two of you have very unique personalities and experiences, and Ms. Turenna is also a most responsible person...

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: So if the two of you were to play a few matches, we should be able to discover many in-game limitations, and that will help with further improvements.

choices.text: Alright! Time for a new game!

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: Since even the Super Zenith Boss-Level Forces are absolutely interested, and this will make an excellent feather in my resume cap... Of course I'd be happy to help!

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: But I'm well aware that I'm inferior to you in all aspects, so please go easy on me!

choices.text: I was planning on giving it a try anyway!
Is there anything we can help you with?
I believe we've met before, yes?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That voice sure is familiar, but, uh, did we know a lady like her?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Based on your slightly tanned skin, you're not from around here, huh?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait! Paimon kinda remembers now! This is kinda unbelievable, but...

dialogues.speaker: Turenna
dialogues.text: Strong... Too strong... Even if it's just a tabletop game, you're still practically invulnerable!

dialogues.speaker: Turenna
dialogues.text: P—Please go a few more rounds with me and teach me more!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's a little too much, don't you think? We're just playing a game.

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: Please don't try to be humble! This tabletop game can reflect a player's ability to command...

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: The positioning of each Lil' Fungus, their opponent, skill activation rhythm, support timings... Everything is important!

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: You haven't received any command training from the Maison Gardiennage, and yet you're still able to launch joint attacks so skillfully...

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: You're not just a Super Zenith Boss-Level Force, you're a real Super Zenith Boss!

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: Are you interested in taking up a position in the Maison? I'm sure you'd become a captain in no time, and then advance further still into one of the organization's pillars...

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: Um... About that... I'm not very sure. I remember that the monthly salary of ordinary Gardes used to be 300,000 Mora a few years ago... I guess it might've risen slightly by now?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How much is 300,000 Mora per month? It sounds like quite a familiar number to Paimon...

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: I—It can't be helped! The Maison is an executive agency funded by tax money, so of course the pay wouldn't be that high...

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: I understand the respect you feel for them, Ms. Turenna.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Unfortunately, from what I know, they plan on traveling around Teyvat while helping people from all nations to resolve their problems and eliminate monsters...

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: As a recipient of their kindness, I too hope that more shall be able to receive their help.

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: I see...

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: Sowing the seeds of justice and peace throughout Teyvat is indeed more important than merely maintaining order in Fontaine!

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: Then all I can do is... go a few more rounds with you and do my best to understand your way of thinking!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, there's something important we can't forget, Haniyyah...

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: You want to know how Bongo-Head's doing, right?

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Bongo-Head and Kindlejoy are right over there. Ms. Turenna even specially arranged for someone to take care of our Fungi buddies.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: As before, I've prepared special jellies this time too.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: You can play with them while enjoying some snacks together!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright! That's what Paimon's talking about! You really are getting better at this, Haniyyah!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, let's each play a round of Lil' Fungi's Fun-Tastic Fiesta with Turenna, and then we'll go see Bongo-Head!

choices.text: Come now, am I not worth millions?
Ugh! I don't want to go to work!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Yeah, and settling down and working from a fixed location will keep {NICKNAME} from doing what {M#he}{F#she} needs to do.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon doesn't want to be woken up early in the morning and made to work either... It's best to stay free and go wherever our feet might take us.

choices.text: And there will be more choices for our daily meals.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! Delicious food matters too! Settling down means getting bored of the food sooner or later! Changing menus from time to time is the best!

choices.text: And we will have a greater variety of food to enjoy.

talks.objective: Talk to the two people at the stall

dialogues.speaker: Turenna
dialogues.text: Alright then, let's play!

dialogues.speaker: Turenna
dialogues.text: But I'm well aware that I'm inferior to you in all aspects, so please go easy on me!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, Paimon was right! That's Bongo-Head and Kindlejoy!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Please wait! We'll come play with you once we finish talking to Haniyyah and Turenna!
